svg.aria-label: Medical chatbot using RAG with Pinecone, HuggingFace embeddings, LangChain and Flask.

g.text: Answers medical queries from grounded context in a Pinecone vector database instead of letting the
LLM answer unaided. I built the PDF ingestion myself: chunking medical documents and embedding
them with HuggingFace sentence-transformers, then chained retrieval and generation with LangChain
and deployed a Flask app with a real-time chat UI.
